items.title: Louis Barbarin Interview, 1960-06-22
items.q: I have another brother... William Barber. He played around with several organized groups... Lucien Barber and my other brother... he played with the D and... Billy?

ctx.x: Could you tell us some more about your other brothers that played music?

I have another brother. Well, he's learning trumpet. William Barber. He played around with several organized groups and... But he never did keep it up. Lucien Barber and my other brother, which passed, he played with the D and... Billy?
